edits.new:
Then the system refuses the call with status 403 and MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC12 Source not complete at the cut-off (new, NEWAC-RWB-P1-E1002-APP-AC12)
    Given a source the case list reads is not COMPLETED for 2026-11-30 at the cut-off
    When the case list step runs
    Then the daily completeness gate of RWB-P1-E1015-APP holds the workflow
    Then the system writes no case_list_row for 2026-11-30
    Then the last released date stays the one that is served
    Then the message MSG-P1-001 is raised and the data steward and team managers are alerted

  Scenario: AC13 Case account with no ACE row (new, NEWAC-RWB-P1-E1002-APP-AC13)
    Given case account ACC0000456 has no v_ace_account row for 2026-11-30
    When the case list step runs
    Then the row for the case account is written with empty balance and days past due
    Then REC-05 lists the account key for the data steward and the ACE team
    Then the case and the link are unchanged

  Scenario: AC14 Data read only through the contracts and views (new, NEWAC-RWB-P1-E1002-APP-AC14)
    Given the case list for 2026-11-30 is built
    When the workflow reads case data and ACE data
    Then case data is read only through the rwb-case contracts
    Then ACE data is read only through recovery.v_ace_* views

  Scenario: AC15 Error answers of the provided operations (new, NEWAC-RWB-P1-E1002-APP-AC15)
    Given a caller calls GET /case-list/dates/{businessDate} or GET /case-list/rows
    When a call is refused under the condition Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P1-E1002-APP-AC15)
    Then the system answers status 401 or 404 with the problem envelope
